note: WIST-1 §2 Canonical Host. `expected` is the Canonical Host, or null where the input has no canonicalization and a validator MUST reject the `url` carrying it with WIST1-E03.

cases.name: ASCII case and trailing dot
cases.why: §2: UTS #46 mapping folds case; the trailing dot is removed.

cases.name: hyphens in the third and fourth position
cases.why: §2: CheckHyphens=false. Under CheckHyphens=true this host — the shape CDN nodes actually use — has no canonicalization at all.

cases.name: IDN label
cases.why: §2: mapping leaves ü, Punycode encodes it.

cases.name: nontransitional sharp s
cases.why: §2: Transitional_Processing=false keeps ß rather than mapping it to ss.

cases.name: uppercase sigma
cases.why: §2: UTS #46 maps Σ to σ context-free. An implementation that lowercases first with a context-sensitive full lowercase gets ς and therefore xn--mxa8a — a different Canonical Host for the same input, which is why §2 forbids the extra step.

cases.name: A-label passthrough
cases.why: §2: an already-encoded A-label canonicalizes to itself.

cases.name: STD3 violation
cases.why: §2: UseSTD3ASCIIRules=true rejects ASCII outside letters, digits and hyphen.

cases.name: label too long
cases.why: §2: VerifyDnsLength=true bounds a label at 63 octets.

cases.name: zero-width non-joiner out of context
cases.why: §2: CheckJoiners=true — U+200C is admissible only after a virama or in a joining context, and 'a' is neither.

cases.name: bidi violation
cases.why: §2: CheckBidi=true — an RTL label may not carry a strong LTR character.
